'''Conference Room 68''' was a room on the [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']]. It was there that [[Bosmihi]] and [[Vilim Disra]] negotiated the terms of [[Kroctar]]'s surrender to the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].
